information: Please note, the 3x3x3 event is **NOT** being held at this competition as it is focused on side events. ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! [Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au) Speedcubing Australia acknowledges the traditional owners of this land, the Kaurna people, and pays respect to the elders, past and present for they hold the memories, the traditions, the culture and hopes of Aboriginal Australia.
